integrity: The finite statement is proven by exhaustive, graph-rooted enumeration with an independent BWT/LF generator; the complete reproducible Python certificate is included.
scientific_limitations: Finite complete classification of binary order-five de Bruijn cycles only; no all-order expression; no bit-size compression conclusion; previously unindexed equivalent enumeration possible. One related full 2024 chapter was not obtained, although an author presentation was examined.
title: Exact cyclic BWT run spectrum of binary de Bruijn cycles of order five
